subject: general
question: Padma Vibhushan awardee, Pandit Birju Maharaj was a _________ dancer of India.
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Kathak__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Padma Vibhushan awardee, Pandit Birju Maharaj was the Famous **Kathak **Dancer.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj belongs to **Lucknow Gharana.**
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj got the Highest Civilian Award **Padma Vibhushan **in the Year **1986.**
